input_requirement: Inputs must first receive the same Stage 1 unusual-code handling and flag construction.
feature_engineering: For the composite representation only: total_delinquency = late_30_59 + 2*late_60_89 + 3*late_90. Missing components produce a missing total.
processing_order: Replace missing feature values with exported imputation values.
Apply each exported upper cap where indicated.
Apply log1p where indicated, using the natural logarithm.
Multiply processed values by their exported points multipliers.
Sum contributions and add the manual intercept.
income_interpretation: When income uses log1p, its multiplier applies to ln(1 + monthly_inc), not directly to raw income.
reference_interpretation: The original base_points is the score at the mean of the processed training predictors. This combination need not represent an actual borrower.
contribution_interpretation: Centred feature contributions describe score changes relative to processed training means. They are model contributions, not validated lending reason codes.
